ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: First describe the image: in the image, the Ming Great Wall extends roughly east-west in a winding-line shape, with the western end marked “Jiayuguan,” passing eastward near “Juyongguan” and “Beijing,” and the eastern end reaching “Shanhaiguan”; overall it is located in northern China, with no obvious extension toward the southern region south of the Qinling–Huaihe line. Then reason: the route of the Ming Great Wall passes through Northwest China, North China, and the southern part of Northeast China, and may cross temperate natural zones such as the temperate desert zone, temperate grassland zone, and temperate deciduous broad-leaved forest zone; while the subtropical evergreen broad-leaved forest zone is mainly distributed in the southern region south of the Qinling–Huaihe line, and the Great Wall route shown in the figure does not reach this area. Therefore, the natural zone that the Ming Great Wall did not cross is the subtropical evergreen broad-leaved forest zone.

method.method_draft: 先观察图像：图中明长城呈东西向分布，西起嘉峪关，向东经过北京附近的居庸关，至山海关，整体位于中国北方地区，没有向南延伸到秦岭—淮河以南。再读取题干文字：问题要求判断“明长城没有跨越哪个自然带”。结合地理知识判断：明长城沿线可经过西北干旱、半干旱区和华北、东北南部的温带自然带，如温带荒漠带、温带草原带、温带落叶阔叶林带等；而亚热带常绿阔叶林带主要分布在秦岭—淮河以南的南方地区，图示长城路线没有到达该区域。因此答案为“亚热带常绿阔叶林带”。
